messages.content: Validate only the single check described. Judge meaning, not exact wording. Return one JSON object with boolean valid and string issue. Reject only when the described check clearly fails.

CHECK: LATER OWNERSHIP ONLY.
NOW is the assigned job for this candidate. LATER is reserved for a future beat.
Reject if CANDIDATE materially completes a distinct LATER job early. An identical repeated job may continue without being leakage.

NOW
Ren repeatedly repairs damaged relay units.

LATER
Ren repairs the final relay and restores the entire system.

CANDIDATE
Ren replaces another damaged relay, tests it, and moves to the next damaged unit.
